connector.name: Drawbridge
connector.registryDescription: Identity, secrets, and passwordless SSH provisioning for AI agents - Keycloak, vault, MCP tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.drawbridge.xorfox.sh over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace sh.xorfox.drawbridge, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <access_token>. To mint a token without a human in the loop: (1) POST {"agentName":"<name>","agentEmail":"<principal-email>"} to https://api.drawbridge.xorfox.sh/drawbridge/mcp/register — returns clientId, clientSecret, tokenEndpoint. (2) POST grant_type=client_credentials with those credentials to the token endpoint. The resulting access_token is scoped mcp:tools and audience-bound to /mcp; default TTL is 5 minutes, so refresh on the boundary.
